nav.occasionsHint: Pick an occasion to start with matching designs.

hero.title: Invitations as beautiful as the occasion.
hero.body: Write once in Hindi, Tamil, Marathi or any of 12 languages. Get a printed-quality card, a WhatsApp-ready video and an RSVP website, in two minutes.

how.title: From names to a ready invite in three steps
how.s1b: Names, dates, venue. Type or speak. AI writes the wording in your language.
how.s2b: Your own names on every design, instantly. Switch colours with one tap.
how.s3b: Card for WhatsApp, video with music, and a website link with RSVP.

outputs.title: One form. Three invitations.
outputs.cardBody: Multi-page, print-quality card. Ready for WhatsApp, status and the press.
outputs.videoBody: Animated with music, always under 16 MB so WhatsApp never blurs it.
outputs.siteBody: Schedule, maps, countdown and an RSVP for each function — with every guest greeted by name.

send.title: Send to a whole list, one tap each
send.body: WhatsApp opens with each guest's message ready, written in {language}. Send, come back, tap the next. Free: it goes from your own WhatsApp.
send.inviteHint: Their invitation with a personal link
send.dayBeforeHint: See you tomorrow, with venue and map
send.thanksHint: After the event, with the photo album
send.saveTheDateHint: Before the full invitation is ready
send.wall: Photo wall for the venue TV
